newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - June 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - June 26.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
* U.S. President Bill Clinton has unveiled tough new controls on soot and smog.

* The U.S. Supreme Court struck down the Religious Freedom Restoration Act, which was enacted by Congress four years ago, contending the power to interpret the Constitution is in the court's jurisdiction, not in other branches of government.
* A cargo vessel crashed into Russia's Mir space station during a practice docking.
* British Prime Minister Tony Blair unveiled a new plan for all-party peace talks on Northern Island, and challenged Sinn Fein to make an "absolute commitment" to nonviolence.
* Jacques-Yves Cousteau, the French oceanographer who took the world along on his underwater expeditions, died at age 87.
* Princess Diana's clothing collection went on the auction block, reeling in $3.25 million for charities benefiting cancer and AIDS.
